learning_outcomes.text: The student has the necessary knowledge for using computers, developing software programs and applications, information processing.
The student has the ability to develop, design and create new applications, systems or products using best practices of the field.
The student has the necessary skills for computer program design and software systems analysis.
The student has the ability to work independently to combine diverse information to formulate solutions and generate ideas for developing new products and applications.

assessment_methods.method: Evaluation by the internship tutor from the internship institution

assessment_rules: Students are required to complete 120 hours of internship. Successfully passing the examination is conditioned by a minimum grade of 5.
